== Lead photograph (30 Oct 2026) ==
The lead is a crop of a Facebook photograph posted 30 July 2016. The Facebook photo viewer names Benoit Morel. Identification: distinctive name plus Red 80 on the Decipher Squadron roster (Orleans, Fr). The Facebook profile is facebook.com/benoit.morel.5836.
Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot. Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Benoit Morel portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Benoit Morel Facebook portrait.jpg]].
